sentences.en: It is probable that he will win the speech contest.
sentences.zh: 他赢得演讲比赛的可能性很大。

sentences.en: His misspelling of that word eliminated him from the contest.
sentences.zh: 他对那个单词的拼写错误使他失去了参赛资格。

sentences.en: In the contest he fully displayed what ability he had.
sentences.zh: 在这场比赛中，他充分展示了自己所有的能力。
